overview: SASHA SERVIÇO is a complete multi-sector business management system for a gas station, bar, and barbershop. It features role-based dashboards for owners, admins, and employees — with financial tracking, employee management, GPS attendance, meeting scheduling, reporting, and notifications.
features: Role-based dashboards for Owner, Admin, and Employee
Financial management — income and expense tracking by department
Employee directory with profiles, performance scores, and photo uploads
GPS attendance check-in/out with browser geolocation
Financial reports by day, week, month, or year with department breakdown
Supports 3 departments: Gas Station, Bar, and Barbershop
